subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel-contact physics plus pose, orientation and chassis transforms, together with their collision, tire, UI-display and physics-constant support services: float-to-double pose promotion and orientation-matrix build with network serialization, suspension spring/damper force accumulation, suspension travel ratio clamping, wheel-contact proximity checking, local-to-world and chassis point transforms, per-wheel contact flag writing, collision configuration sync and collision-global zeroing, recursive broadphase AABB traversal, collision position stepping, collision node list insertion, active physics channel scanning, indirect object-store dispatch, suspension-force visualization, tire state-block reset, tire-model constant cleanup, and vehicle HUD display accessors.

summary: DERIVED architecture for the vehicle_physics scope from 25 validated functions. A VehiclePhysicsState object (DERIVED) carries the per-frame suspension and wheel-contact physics: 0x004E58D0 (AccumulateSuspensionSpringDamperForce) accumulates a -9.81 gravity-scaled, stiffness-combined spring/damper force per corner into this[0x354C]/[0x3550]/[0x3554]; 0x004E8780 (SuspensionRatioClamp) returns the negated, [0,1]-clamped travel ratio this[0x39A8]/this[0x39AC]; 0x004E96C0 (Vehicle_Wheel_Contact_Proximity_Check) checks wheel-contact proximity with movement dead-zones, a rotation alignment split, and PositionChangeMonitor (0x004E9630) against the threshold at this+0x3B6C; 0x004B9CC0 (VehicleSpeedAccessor) reads the nested speed float at obj+0xF34. A VehiclePoseTransform group (GUESS) promotes float position/rotation to double (0x00459830) and builds the orientation matrix with network serialization (0x0045B050); a VehicleChassisTransform group (GUESS) applies local-to-world and chassis point transforms (0x004E2070, 0x004E2130). VehicleWheelContact (DERIVED) writes per-wheel contact flags (0x004EF560). Collision support classes (all GUESS): CollisionBroadphaseTraversal (0x00491170), CollisionPositionStepper (0x0048CB00), CollisionNodeList (0x004BAD70) and CollisionGlobalState (0x00475D30 configuration sync, 0x00494600 global zeroing). PhysicsObjectFactory (GUESS) dispatches through dword_7CD8C0 (0x004780B0, 0x0047A290); PhysicsConstantGlobals (GUESS) manages tire-model constant frees and the global physics vector (0x004F23C0, 0x004C7C50); TireStateBlock (GUESS) is zeroed by 0x004DFB90. VehicleHudDisplay (GUESS) covers the description getter, UI edit init, position/count formatting and the vehicle-list count (0x00463C80, 0x00474AB0, 0x0049C6D0, 0x004B8140); PhysicsChannelSet (GUESS) scans active physics channels (0x0045B580); SuspensionForceVisualizer (GUESS) draws the 2D suspension-force view (0x00475A90). All owners except the packet-listed VehicleWheelContact are worker proposals; none are packet-confirmed.

function_roles.role: Promotes float position (this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC) and rotation (this+0x10/+0x14/+0x18) to double: stores the position as three doubles at this+0xD8 and the computed 3x3 rotation tensor at this+0x138 via F_3x3RotationTensorMatrixTransform (0x005691D0), propagates the six dwords via Copy6DwordsToStructCall (0x00569280), copies the float position into this+0xC0/+0xC4/+0xC8 and into output a2, and returns a2. When the trigger flag at this+0xD0 is set, the external-processing call sub_54B4D0 (0x0054B4D0) and BufferEntryClear(0x8000000) (0x0054FAE0) run before the conversion. Invoked by StateDependentUpdateDispatch (0x0040F130).

Builds the vehicle orientation matrix as consecutive float triplets from this+0x60 using the negated velocity/direction components at this+0x108/+0x110/+0x118 and a sign-adjusted up component from this+0x318 with horizontal normalization from this+0x320 (zero-magnitude guarded), fills the matrix rows this+0x6C..0xBC, then serializes eight 12-byte matrix rows through NetworkPacketDataWriter (0x0054FA00). Returns the last writer result.

Scans up to 8 physics channels (23-float / 0x5C-byte stride) starting at this+36 (0x90). A channel is active when its first float is greater than 0.0. Returns the flat channel index (0-7) of the (a2+1)-th active channel, or 0 when fewer than a2+1 active channels exist. Invoked by sub_45B5C0 (0x0045B5C0).

Gets the vehicle description string: reads the object vtable first dword, adds 0xB4, and dereferences the resulting address as char*; returns the string when non-null, otherwise the fallback global byte_5EA438.

Initializes a UI edit control: stores a pointer to the visible-vehicle-index global dword_7CFC8C at this+0x320 and a snapshot of the championship/race-mode global dword_7D0410 at this+0x324, formats the vehicle index with the '%d' format string global (0x005C3280) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F), and pushes the text into the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate (0x0048B810). Returns 0. Invoked by UIListInitWithDefault (0x00474A10).

Draws a 2D suspension-force visualization for the vehicle context at byte_7C56C0: after context setup sub_4881F0 (0x004881F0), guards on two UtilityFunction_7160 (0x00487160) anchor lookups, computes a wheel-speed pixel offset from dword_7C6C44/dbl_7C6C38/dbl_7C6C30 scaled by 9.549296585513721*0.0001, selects km/h (3.6) or mph (2.236936292054402) by byte_7D0474, reads the joint count via DynamicsJointCount (0x00431820), accumulates per-joint forces via TireSuspensionForceComputation (0x00431850), and draws line segments via ConditionalDraw (0x00475C80) and OffsetPositionComputation (0x00475CC0) with CRTFtol (0x00587BDC). Returns 0.

Frame-change collision configuration sync: when the stored version dword_7CD614 differs from the current frame counter/version dword_7CE250, stamps the new version, updates physics module data from the module pointer array 0x007CA590 via ShortComputation_5bd0 (0x00455BD0), and reconfigures the contact stiffness and collision arrays (0x007CD458, 0x007CD45C, 0x007CD2B0, 0x007CD610) plus the value read from dbl_8AFE90 via sub_454DA0 (0x00454DA0). Invoked from F_2DRectangleDrawingWithOutline (0x00475D90).

Indirect factory-style store: calls the virtual method at vtable offset 28 on the object referenced by dword_7CD8C0 with literal argument 21; when the returned pointer is non-null it is stored at this+0xE0 (this[56]). Returns 0.

Clamps a suspension float across a global array: initializes display/dispatch state via SetupValueDisplayFormatter (0x00466910), fetches a source object through the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface (slot +0x1C, command 9), and when the source exists and the enable flag byte at this+0x100 is set, retrieves the value through this vtable slot +0xB4, validates the source with ZeroCheckGetter (0x00490190), and writes/clamps the value across the array from unk_7D17CC to flt_7D1B2C (27 dwords per element, bounds in element dwords 3 and 4). Returns 0.

Steps a collision/animation position toward a target over time: total range = step (this+0x32C) x multiplier (this+0x328); accumulates a2 into this+0x340 and converts to a step count via CRTFtol(accumulator * 14.999999) (0x00587BDC); per step recomputes the target offset from this+0x338/this+0x334, wraps modulo the range, moves by the direction sign (byte this+0x33C) at a 0.444 rate with a minimum step of 1, wraps this+0x334, invokes the update callback through vtable slot 11 (obj+0x2C) with argument 1, and decrements the accumulator by 0.06666667 (1/15, flt_5AC108). Early-outs when the range or step count is non-positive.

Recursive broadphase AABB traversal over a linked list: copies the head (this+0x0) into the cursor (this+0x8), walks nodes testing each node's four short AABB coordinates (offsets 0x0/0x2/0x4/0x6) against the next node with AABBOverlapTest (0x004915A0) returning 1 on the first overlap; when sub_491680 (0x00491680) accepts an AABB, RectangleClipping (0x00491350) produces a clip-result list that is recursed into (self 0x00491170) and re-linked via LinkedListNodePrepend (0x00490AA0). Returns 1 on a hit, 0 when the list is exhausted without overlap.
Zeroes four collision-system global DWORDs at 0x007CDDF0-0x007CDDFC and returns 0; runs on the collision system reset/shutdown path. No static callers are recorded in the packet.

Formats the current race position and total vehicle count into the output buffer a1 as the '%d/%d' pattern via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F): the position numerator is read from dword_7C54E0 + 16480, the vehicle-count denominator from dword_5C329C. Returns 0. Called by FormatRegisterDispatch (0x0049D440), DrawDebugTextOverlay (0x004DBB60) and MultiLayerTextStringRenderer (0x004DBC90).

Trivial getter returning the dword at this+0x6CC (this[435]); no side effects, no guards, no callees. The vehicle-list-count interpretation comes from the legacy ABI name; the raw source only reads the field.
Read accessor: loads the object pointer at this[0], reads the float at offset 0xF34 of the nested object, and returns it widened to double. The speed interpretation is not proven by this packet.

Linked-list insertion on a list object with head/tail/count at this+0x0..0xC: when a2 is non-null, allocates a 12-byte node (flag byte 1, data = a2) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) (0x00587C03) and appends it to the primary list. When byte a3 is zero, a second staggered pass walks *a2 plus a 884-byte stride and appends one flag-byte-0 node per stride position to a second list at this+0x10..0x1C. Returns the countdown result (0 after the loop). Called by NetworkMessageDispatch (0x004B54E0).
Forwards to sub_4C7E80 with the address of the global float flt_8AC4B0 (0x008AC4B0) and returns the callee's result. The packet lists no callee entry for the target.

Constructor-style zero-initializer for a small tire-related state block: clears the byte fields at this+0x0/+0x1 and the six dword fields at this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18, then returns 0. Invoked from PhysicsTireSystemConstructor (0x004E4500), VehicleResetClear (0x004E09E0) and sub_4DFBB0 (0x004DFBB0).

3D local-to-world coordinate transform: builds a combined offset vector from the camera-relative offset (this[573..575], 0x8F4/0x8F8/0x8FC) summed with an additional offset (this[576..578], 0x900/0x904/0x908), multiplies by the 3x3 rotation matrix (this+0x20..0x40) into output a2, adds the base position (this+0x8..0x10), copies the matrix block into a local buffer (never read), then calls sub_567120 (0x00567120) with this+579 and forwards a3; returns the callee result. Invoked by CameraModeViewportUpdate (0x00409A00).

Transforms a 3D point by the chassis rotation/scale at this+0x14..0x40 combined with per-component scale factors at this+0x918..0x920, adds the translation read from the three floats preceding the matrix origin (this+0x8..0x10), writes output a2, copies three DWORDs at this+0x14..0x1C into output a3, and returns a3. No guards; the transform is always applied.

Per-frame suspension spring/damper force accumulation for one corner: computes the gravity-scaled force from this[0x3514] * -9.81, projects it via the rotation matrix at 0x34B0..0x34D0, derives the displacement as the mount position (0x34F8..0x3500) minus the rotated rest anchor (0x3A58..0x3A60), squares each component, combines each squared displacement with its axis stiffness (0x3A64/0x3A68/0x3A6C) with FCOM-selected add/subtract, folds a cross-coupling term (0x3A70/0x3A74) into this[0x3558] on one axis, and accumulates the three results into this[0x354C]/[0x3550]/[0x3554]. No callees. Invoked from PhysicsIntegrationStateMachine (0x004E4E60).

Computes the negated ratio of two suspension travel values (numerator this+0x39A8, denominator this+0x39AC) and clamps the result into [0.0, 1.0]: a zero-denominator guard returns 0.0, a negative ratio returns 0.0, a ratio above 1.0 returns 1.0. Per-frame path, called by AISteeringCorrection (0x00426CF0).

Per-vehicle wheel-contact proximity check on the frame path: computes the squared position delta between the current history slots (0x3AAC/0x3AB0/0x3AB4) and the recorded position triplet (0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC), returns 0 in the dead-zone (flag this+0x32BC, thresholds dbl_5AD1C8 / dbl_5AD1D0), rolls the recorded position into history; on high rotation alignment (dot this+0x34C0 >= 0.94999999, flt_59EE8C) runs the full proximity test through PositionChangeMonitor (0x004E9630), projecting the recorded offset onto the monitor basis and testing extents at offsets 88/92 against the threshold at this+0x3B6C; on low alignment scans up to 4 active contact entries at this+0x828 (stride 296, active byte +0x868); returns 1 when alignment drops below 0.70710677 (flt_5AD1C4) or when no condition disqualifies.

Per-wheel contact writer reached from the tire slip-force path: indexes this by a 28-byte stride a2 to select one wheel record, stores the contact/state flag bytes a3/a4 at byte offsets 15224 and 15225 of the record, copies the 3-dword vector at a5 into byte offset 15240, and returns a pointer to the copied vector. Packet owner tag: VehicleWheelContact.

Cleanup routine freeing six heap allocations (global pointers 0x008ADB00, 0x008ADB0C, 0x008ADB14, 0x008ADB1C, 0x008ADB24, 0x008ADB2C) via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Each pointer is individually null-guarded; the last FreeWrapper return value (or 0) is returned. No static callers are recorded in the packet.

classes.name: VehiclePoseTransform
classes.responsibility: Pose promotion and orientation build on a vehicle-like object: promotes float position/rotation to double and builds the orientation matrix, then serializes it for network transmission.

classes.name: VehicleChassisTransform
classes.responsibility: Local-to-world and chassis point transforms: rotates/scales a local point by the object matrix and per-component scale factors, adds the base translation, and emits a DWORD triple copy.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsState
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle suspension and wheel-contact physics state: spring/damper force accumulation, travel-ratio clamping, wheel-contact proximity checking and speed access, over the 0x32BC..0x3B6C suspension/contact region plus the nested speed field at obj+0xF34.

classes.name: VehicleWheelContact
classes.responsibility: Per-wheel contact record writer: stores two contact/state flag bytes and a 3-dword vector into the 28-byte-stride wheel record selected by the caller.

classes.name: CollisionBroadphaseTraversal
classes.responsibility: Recursive broadphase AABB linked-list traversal with rectangle clipping of accepted nodes and output re-linking.

classes.name: CollisionPositionStepper
classes.responsibility: Time-based position stepping for a collision/animation position: converts an accumulated time into steps, moves toward a target at a fixed rate with wrap-around, and invokes a vtable-slot-11 update callback.

classes.name: CollisionNodeList
classes.responsibility: Dual linked list (primary at this+0x0..0xC, secondary at this+0x10..0x1C) of 12-byte nodes with a flag byte; the insertion appends primary data nodes and a staggered 884-byte-stride secondary pass.

classes.name: CollisionGlobalState
classes.responsibility: Collision subsystem global configuration and state: frame-change configuration version sync over the 0x7CDxxx globals and reset-path zeroing of the 0x7CDDF0 block. No object fields; operates on globals only.

classes.name: PhysicsObjectFactory
classes.responsibility: Indirect object store and value dispatch through the dword_7CD8C0 interface: creates/stores an object via a vtable-offset-28 call with argument 21, and dispatches command 9 through slot +0x1C to clamp a suspension float across a global array.

classes.name: SuspensionForceVisualizer
classes.responsibility: Draws the 2D suspension-force visualization for the shared vehicle context at byte_7C56C0: computes wheel-speed pixel offsets, accumulates per-joint suspension forces, and draws interpolated segments.

classes.name: PhysicsChannelSet
classes.responsibility: Fixed 8-entry array of physics channels at this+0x90 (23-float stride); scans for the (a2+1)-th channel whose first float is positive.

classes.name: PhysicsConstantGlobals
classes.responsibility: Global physics constants and buffers in the 0x8Axxxx region: the freed tire-model constant pointers (0x008ADB00..0x008ADB2C) and the global physics vector at flt_8AC4B0. Free functions; no object context.

classes.name: TireStateBlock
classes.responsibility: Small tire-related state block (two byte flags plus six dwords) reset by a constructor-style zero-initializer on tire-system construction, vehicle reset and sub_4DFBB0 paths.

classes.name: VehicleHudDisplay
classes.responsibility: HUD/UI vehicle-display accessors: vehicle description string getter with a fallback global, UI edit control binding of the visible vehicle index and race mode, position/vehicle-count text formatting, and a vehicle-list count getter.

state_machines.name: WheelContactProximityCheck
transitions: Initial -> DeadZonePinned when the squared position delta is below 0.0009 (dbl_5AD1C8) and the dead-zone enable flag at this+0x32BC is set (return 0)
Initial -> StaticMovement when the squared delta is below 0.000009 (dbl_5AD1D0) with the flag clear (return 0)
-> AlignmentHigh when the rotation alignment dot at this+0x34C0 is >= 0.94999999 (flt_59EE8C); runs the full PositionChangeMonitor (0x004E9630) projection against the threshold at this+0x3B6C
-> AlignmentLow when the alignment dot is below 0.94999999; scans up to 4 active contact entries at this+0x828 (stride 296, active byte +0x868) then falls through to the monitor test
MonitorProjectionTest -> Accepted when the threshold residual exceeds the minimum extent at monitor offset 88 or 92 (positive/negative side) (return 1)
MonitorProjectionTest -> Rejected when the compare-flag pair is clear (return 0)
-> Accepted when the alignment dot drops below 0.70710677 (flt_5AD1C4) (return 1)
The recorded position triplet (this+0x34D4..0x34DC) is rolled into the history slots (this+0x3AAC..0x3AB4) before the monitor test

state_machines.name: CollisionPositionStepping
transitions: Accumulate -> ConvertToSteps only when the total range this+0x32C * this+0x328 is positive
ConvertToSteps: step count = CRTFtol(accumulator * 14.999999) (0x00587BDC); the loop is skipped when the count is non-positive
StepTowardsTarget: recompute the target offset from this+0x338 and this+0x334; move by the direction sign (byte this+0x33C) at a 0.444 rate with a minimum step of 1
StepTowardsTarget -> WrapPosition: wrap this+0x334 modulo the total range in both directions
InvokeCallback -> Accumulate: decrement this+0x340 by 0.06666667 (1/15, flt_5AC108) and continue for v6 steps

state_machines.name: PhysicsChannelScan
transitions: ScanNext: advance the channel pointer by 23 floats (0x5C bytes) from the base at this+0x90
ScanNext -> ActiveChannel when the channel first float is greater than 0.0
ScanNext -> ChannelBound when the flat channel index reaches 8 (return 0, not found)
ActiveChannel -> Found when it is the (a2+1)-th active channel (return the flat index); otherwise count it and continue scanning

interfaces.name: ObjectDispatchInterface7CD8C0
interfaces.purpose: Indirect dispatch root global dword_7CD8C0: PhysicsObjectFactory calls a vtable-offset-28 method with argument 21 (0x004780B0) and dispatches command 9 through slot +0x1C (0x0047A290).

interfaces.name: NetworkPacketDataWriter
interfaces.purpose: Shared packet writer (0x0054FA00) that serializes eight 12-byte orientation-matrix rows for network transmission; BufferEntryClear (0x0054FAE0) clears a buffer entry before the pose conversion path.

interfaces.name: StringFormatInterface
interfaces.purpose: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (0x0058815F) used by both UI edit initialization (0x00474AB0) and race position/vehicle-count formatting (0x0049C6D0).

interfaces.name: CollisionProximityMonitor
interfaces.purpose: PositionChangeMonitor (0x004E9630) consulted by the wheel-contact proximity check; returns a record with a basis (offsets 32/36/40), neighbor records (offsets 268/272) and extent fields (offsets 88/92) used for the positive/negative-side overlap tests.

interfaces.name: PhysicsConstantPool
interfaces.purpose: Shared pool of physics double/float constants (0x59E43C..0x59EE8C, 0x5AD1C4..0x5AD1D0, the 0x8Axxxx tire-model and collision globals) read across the suspension, proximity, stepper and cleanup functions; several are folded into compiler-inlined literals.

compatibility_contracts.name: FloatToDoubleCoordinateTransform
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00459830 must store the double position at this+0xD8 (0x18 bytes) and the computed 3x3 rotation tensor at this+0x138 (0x18 bytes) via F_3x3RotationTensorMatrixTransform (0x005691D0), propagate the six dwords via Copy6DwordsToStructCall (0x00569280), and copy the float position as three dwords into this+0xC0/+0xC4/+0xC8 and the output a2; when the trigger flag at this+0xD0 is non-zero the external-processing call sub_54B4D0 (0x0054B4D0) and BufferEntryClear(0x8000000) (0x0054FAE0) must run before the conversion.

compatibility_contracts.name: OrientationMatrixNetworkSerialization
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0045B050 must serialize exactly eight 12-byte orientation-matrix rows through NetworkPacketDataWriter (0x0054FA00), reading the rows back through the this+0x64/0x68/0x60 row pointers; the matrix at this+0x60..0xBC is built from the negated direction components (0x108/0x110/0x118) and the normalized up component (0x318/0x320) with a zero-magnitude guard on the this+0x64/this+0x68 slot.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionConfigurationVersionSync
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00475D30 must compare the stored version dword_7CD614 against dword_7CE250 and, when different, stamp the new version, call ShortComputation_5bd0 (0x00455BD0) on the module pointer array at 0x007CA590, and call sub_454DA0 (0x00454DA0) with the collision parameter arrays 0x007CD458/0x007CD45C/0x007CD2B0/0x007CD610 and the value read from dbl_8AFE90.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactProximityThresholds
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004E96C0 must preserve the movement dead-zones (squared delta below 0.0009 then 0.000009 via dbl_5AD1C8/dbl_5AD1D0, gated by the dead-zone flag at this+0x32BC), the rotation alignment split at 0.94999999 (flt_59EE8C), the very-low-alignment exit at 0.70710677 (flt_5AD1C4), and the threshold at this+0x3B6C; the recorded position triplet (this+0x34D4..0x34DC) is rolled into the history slots (this+0x3AAC..0x3AB4) before the monitor test.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionSpringDamperAccumulation
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004E58D0 must compute the gravity-scaled force from this[0x3514] * -9.81, project it by the rotation matrix at 0x34B0..0x34D0, combine each squared displacement component (mount 0x34F8..0x3500 minus rest anchor 0x3A58..0x3A60) with its axis stiffness (0x3A64/0x3A68/0x3A6C), fold the cross-coupling term (0x3A70/0x3A74) into this[0x3558] on the third axis, and accumulate the per-axis results into this[0x354C]/[0x3550]/[0x3554].

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionRatioClampContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004E8780 must return 0.0 when the denominator this+0x39AC is zero, compute the negated ratio -(this[0x39A8] / this[0x39AC]), and clamp the result into [0.0, 1.0].

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionPositionStepSequence
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0048CB00 must accumulate the time delta a2 into this+0x340, convert to a step count with CRTFtol(accumulator * 14.999999) (0x00587BDC), step at a 0.444 rate with a minimum step of 1, wrap the position at this+0x334 modulo the range this+0x32C * this+0x328 in both directions, invoke the vtable-slot-11 (obj+0x2C) update callback with argument 1, and decrement the accumulator by 0.06666667 (1/15, flt_5AC108) per step.

compatibility_contracts.name: BroadphaseAABBTraversalContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00491170 must test each node's four short AABB coordinates (offsets 0x0/0x2/0x4/0x6) against the next node via AABBOverlapTest (0x004915A0), recurse into RectangleClipping (0x00491350) clip results (self-call 0x00491170) and re-link them with LinkedListNodePrepend (0x00490AA0), returning 1 on the first overlap and 0 when the list is exhausted.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsChannelStrideContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0045B580 must scan at most 8 channels of stride 0x5C (23 floats) from this+0x90 and treat a channel as active when its first float is greater than 0.0, returning the (a2+1)-th active flat index (0-7) or 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionGlobalZeroContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00494600 must zero the four collision-system global DWORDs at 0x007CDDF0-0x007CDDFC and return 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireStateResetContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004DFB90 must clear the byte pair at this+0x0/+0x1 and the six dwords at this+0x4/+0x8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18 of the tire state block and return 0; it is invoked on tire-system construction, vehicle reset and the sub_4DFBB0 path.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireModelConstantsFreeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004F23C0 must null-guard and free the six pointer globals 0x008ADB00/0x008ADB0C/0x008ADB14/0x008ADB1C/0x008ADB24/0x008ADB2C via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), returning the last FreeWrapper result or 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionNodeInsertionLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x004BAD70 must allocate 12-byte nodes (data pointer, next pointer, flag byte at +8) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) (0x00587C03), append them to the primary list at this+0x0..0xC and, when a3 == 0, to the secondary list at this+0x10..0x1C while walking a 884-byte stride over *a2.

unresolved: All class owners except the packet-listed VehicleWheelContact (DERIVED for 0x004EF560) are worker proposals; every other packet owner tag is UnknownObject, so ownership is unproven.

The grouping of the this+0x4..0x138 (pose promotion), this+0x60..0x320 (orientation build) and this+0x8F4..0x920 (transform scales) regions into VehiclePoseTransform/VehicleChassisTransform is a worker proposal; the packet provides no common-ownership proof between the functions.

Whether the double reads at this+0x108/0x110/0x118 and this+0x318/0x320 in 0x0045B050 alias the float matrix region is not expressible from the raw text; the serialized network row layout overlaps the freshly-written matrix.
The trigger flag at this+0xD0, the buffer identifier 0x8000000, and the destination struct written by Copy6DwordsToStructCall (0x00569280) in 0x00459830 are not established by the packet.

The 884-byte stride and the *a2 base walked by the secondary pass of 0x004BAD70 imply a fixed-size per-entry layout that is unknown; the meaning of the node flag byte at +8 (1 primary / 0 secondary) and of argument a3 is caller-defined.
